thread:
emma: Quick flag — saw a gap in how we recognised the annual commit credits on invoice INV-8872 for customer Skylark. They applied a $120k prepaid credit on 3/10, but our rev schedule shows full recognition in Mar instead of amortizing. Can someone confirm whether this should be deferred over 12 months or treated as immediate contra-revenue?

sahil: Do you have the breakdown of how the credit was applied on the invoice? Is it reducing MRR or billed as a one-off credit line?

emma: It's a single line item "Annual commit credit" on the invoice, amount $120,000, invoice date 2026-03-10, term 12 months (customer committed). Sales memo attached in Drive: https://drive.redwood/skylark/commit-memo (perm view).

amy: FYI sales told us they intended this to offset monthly subscription charges across the year, not to fully write off in month of invoice. I added a note in the memo.

ryan: From ASC 606 perspective we should recognise revenue as performance obligations are satisfied. If the credit reduces consideration over the contract term, we should defer and amortize. Immediate recognition would overstate revenue in Mar.

iqbal: Agree with ryan. Journal approach: 1) Record customer invoice gross as usual. 2) Post a deferral (CR Revenue, DR Deferred Revenue Liability) for the $120k to be amortized monthly. Example journal for initial adjustment: ```DR Sales Revenue 120,000 \nCR Deferred Revenue - Contract Liabilities 120,000``` Then amortize monthly: ```DR Deferred Revenue 10,000 \nCR Revenue 10,000``` for 12 months.

emma: Thanks — quick question on GL mapping: do we use 4001 for Sales Revenue and 2190 for Deferred Revenue? Last month we used 2195 for prepaid credits.

sahil: Use 2190 for contract liabilities in this case. 2195 was for one-off refunds/prepaids; this is a contract-level deferral. I'll update the rev schedule mapping.

emma: Can we get sign-off to post the reclassing journal this period? It's material to Mar close (~$120k).

ryan: I approve the deferral journal and monthly amortization schedule. Please include a memo and reference INV-8872 in the journal.

amy: Approved from Rev Ops. I'll add a line in the revenue schedule (revrec tab) and notify ops to update billing so future invoices show monthly offset.

emma: Great — I'll prepare the JE in NetSuite and tag it for review. ETA EOD today.

close-bot: Reminder: month-end JE cutoff is 3/20 18:00 PT. Ensure supporting docs uploaded to the close folder. :bell:

emma: Uploaded JE draft and supporting memo: https://drive.redwood/close/mar2026/INV-8872-je-draft. Tagging @sahil for posting after review.

sahil: I'll post after a quick validation tomorrow morning. Thanks all.

ryan: One more note — track the deferred balance in the monthly close checklist so we can reconcile with the deferred revenue rollforward.

emma: Will do. Closing this thread once JE posted.
